title: The Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2026 — 100K official results
claims: The 2026 Canyons 100K was held on 25 April 2026 over 100.00 km with 3,750 m of gain and lists 678 results.
The 2026 100K men's podium was Adam Peterman 08:18:47, Zach Miller 08:21:05 and Hayden Hawks 08:23:28; Canhua Luo was fourth in 08:25:17.
The 2026 100K women's podium was Riley Brady 09:41:09, Careth Arnold 09:56:36 and Sarah Allaben 10:14:58.
